test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following schemes aims to provide an integrated property validation solution for rural India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SVAMITVA.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **SVAMITVA** scheme aims to provide an i**ntegrated property validation **solution for rural India.
 
• The scheme was launched by the **Ministry of Panchayati Raj **in **April 2020.**
 
• The objective of the scheme is to survey rural inhabited lands using **drones** and provide **property cards** to the landowners.
 
• The property cards will help in **reducing property-related disputes**, enable landowners to use their property as **collateral for loans,** and improve the overall rural economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **WDF** (Women Development Fund) is a scheme launched by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development.**

 
 
• Its goal is** **to provide financial assistance to **women entrepreneurs. **
 
 
 
• **NRLM **(National Rural Livelihood Mission) is a **poverty alleviation scheme.**
 
 
• It was launched by the** Ministry of Rural Development.**
 
 
 
• **PCGS** (Partial Credit Guarantee Scheme) is a scheme launched by the **Ministry of Finance** to provide credit guarantee to lenders for loans given to **MSMEs.**
